bounty.title: [FE-FINAL-35] Real-Time Multi-Currency Valuation Switcher (XLM, USDC, EURC, BTC, ETH) via Live Stellar DEX Oracles
bounty.body:
### [FE-FINAL-35] Real-Time Multi-Currency Valuation Switcher (XLM, USDC, EURC, BTC, ETH) via Live Stellar DEX Oracles

- **Category**: `Frontend`
- **Estimated Time to Complete (ETA)**: `2-3 Days (Sprint: Frontend Production Hardening)`
- **Labels**: `frontend, advanced, production-readiness, Currency, i18n`
- **Target Files**: `frontend/src/lib/tokenAmounts.ts, frontend/app/components/CurrencySwitcher.tsx`

#### Compounded Sub-tasks
- [ ] **Easy: Audit existing frontend/src/lib/tokenAmounts.ts implementation**
- [ ] **Medium: Build robust production interface logic**
- [ ] **Advanced: Implement comprehensive test coverage, accessibility verification, and performance optimizations**

#### Problem Statement
Displaying escrow and bounty values solely in raw stroops or lumens confuses international enterprise users operating in USD or EUR denominations.

#### Technical Architecture & Solution
Build a global currency conversion switcher. Fetch live Stellar DEX and oracle rates to display all gas, fee, and escrow values in XLM, USDC, EURC, BTC, or ETH.

#### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 1-click currency switching applies across entire dashboard
- [ ] live prices cache in SWR with 30s TTL
- [ ] formatters respect regional currency conventions.
